wiki.title: Greg Rothman
wiki.extract: William Gregory Rothman (born December 10, 1966) is an American politician and businessman. He has been a Republican member of the Pennsylvania State Senate for the 34th district since 2023. Rothman previously represented the 87th district in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from 2015 to 2022. In 2025, he was elected chairman of the Pennsylvania Republican Party.
